messages.subject: Case study competition - winners announced!
parts:
Hi all,

I am very happy to (finally!) announce the winners of the 1st ggplot2
case study competition (list on http://ggplot2.wik.is/). The winners
are:

Mapping orientation of coral reef fish, by Jean-Olivier Irisson
Flying over the USA, by Heike Hofmann.

They'll each receive a copy of the useR book of their choice.

Thanks to everyone who entered - it was great to see some of the many
ways that people are using ggplot2.

Regards,

Hadley
